title: 5b-3: staleness detection + lazy recompute trigger
description:
## Parent

sutra/44 (5b PRD: component discovery + vocabulary)

## What to build

Make component clustering demand-driven. Store edge count at last clustering run in a metadata row. On any component query, check staleness: stale if (a) files added/removed since last run, or (b) >10% of inter-file edges changed. If stale, trigger reconciliation automatically before returning results. Staleness threshold configurable in `.sutra/components.toml`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Edge count at last clustering stored in metadata
- [ ] Staleness detected when files added/removed since last clustering
- [ ] Staleness detected when >10% of inter-file edges changed
- [ ] First component query after staleness triggers recompute + reconciliation
- [ ] Staleness threshold overridable in `.sutra/components.toml`
- [ ] Non-stale queries return cached results without recomputing

## Blocked by

- sutra/46 (5b-2: component reconciliation)

implementation_plan: Pipeline-side staleness detection in discover_components. New durable component_clustering_meta table stores (edge_count, file_count) at last clustering. Staleness = file count changed OR edge delta >threshold (default 10%, configurable). Stale triggers reconciliation; non-stale skips. MCP tool response enriched with clustering metadata.
